templates.name: Agent Workflow (mattpocock × Trellis)
templates.description: Issue-tracker contract, triage roles, domain-docs conventions and the frontend-craft contract (impeccable binding + design-review gate) that let mattpocock/skills and impeccable treat .trellis/ as their state. Includes a phase-map guide; spec delivery is index-driven (the session-start hook injects the packages' index.md files).
